eventTemplate.title: [Camunda Infrastructure] ElasticWrongReplicaCount
eventTemplate.description:
Elasticsearch index {dims} has had zero replicas for more than 1 day — data loss risk on node failure.

Caveats: (1) uses the underscored Prometheus spelling — same collector-scrape reasoning as elastic-high-shards.json. (2) drops the source rule's requirement that the cluster have more than 1 data node (excluding intentional single-node dev clusters) — a cross-metric join a STATIC_THRESHOLD metric event can't express, same simplification datadog_alerts/ made; scope this to multi-node clusters via a management zone or segment if you have single-node dev clusters in the same tenant. (3) a 1-day `for:` window means 1440 one-minute samples — see elastic-ilm-stopped.json's note on long windows.
